title: Google Ads vs. Yelp Ads for Generating Better Leads for Local Businesses - iCatch Marketing

facts.fact: The iCatch Group article states that the agency has managed campaigns for hundreds of local businesses across industries including plumbing, restoration, roofing, and dentistry.
facts.quote: After managing campaigns for hundreds of local businesses across industries including plumbing, restoration, roofing, remodeling, HVAC, legal services, dentistry

facts.fact: iCatch Group reports being a recipient of the 2025 Yelp Ambassador Award.
facts.quote: We’re also proud recipients of the 2025 Yelp Ambassador Award, and our team serves on the Yelp Partner Agency Advisory Council.

facts.fact: According to the article, Yelp advertising generally uses a pay-per-click model, in which the advertiser sets a budget and pays when prospective customers engage with the ad.
facts.quote: businesses generally advertise using a pay-per-click model, meaning you establish a budget and pay when prospective customers engage with your advertisement.

facts.fact: The article states that Yelp advertising does not have a universal monthly price.
facts.quote: Yelp advertising doesn’t have a universal monthly price.

facts.fact: The article gives a hypothetical example in which a $40 click that consistently produces $6,000 remodeling projects can be more profitable than $6 clicks that never produce qualified leads.
facts.quote: A campaign generating a $40 click that consistently produces $6,000 remodeling projects can be dramatically more profitable than a campaign generating $6 clicks that never produce qualified leads.

facts.fact: The article gives a hypothetical example of one platform charging $12 per click and another averaging $28 per click, noting the more expensive clicks could be more profitable if they convert better.
facts.quote: One platform generates visitors for $12 per click, while another averages $28.

facts.fact: The article's hypothetical example describes $6,000 remodeling projects generated from a $40 click.
The vendor says it has managed advertising campaigns across hundreds of local service businesses.
facts.quote: After managing campaigns across hundreds of local service businesses, we’ve noticed the same mistakes appear repeatedly.

facts.fact: The article describes Yelp Connect as a way for businesses to publish updates, completed projects, seasonal promotions, educational content, and company announcements directly to followers and prospective customers.
facts.quote: Yelp Connect allows businesses to publish updates, completed projects, seasonal promotions, educational content, and company announcements directly to followers and prospective customers.

facts.fact: iCatch Group says it received the 2025 Yelp Ambassador Award.
facts.quote: Our team is proud to have received the 2025 Yelp Ambassador Award, and we serve on the Yelp Partner Agency Advisory Council.
